name: Vanilla Sweet
source:
You (the Main Character) return home on a gap year to take care of the small family Café while your father is ill. 

Here you meet a charming group of “regulars” who help you realise what you really want out of life, and perhaps even brew up some feelings?

[From [url=https://plushiipng.itch.io/vanilla-sweet-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你（主角）在间隔年回家，在你父亲生病期间照顾家庭小咖啡馆。

在这里，你遇到了一群迷人的“常客”，他们帮助你实现生活中真正想要的东西，甚至可能酝酿出一些感情？
